title: Ca*SEA*ta - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Ca*SEA*ta,” your perfect getaway in Seacrest Beach! This luxury home offers comfort for everyone, with an elevator and easy access to two community pools. Take a FREE beach tram to the Gulf’s sugar-white sands or use the 7 included bikes to cruise 30A coast
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Ca*SEA*ta,” your perfect getaway in Seacrest Beach! This luxury home offers comfort for everyone, with an elevator and easy access to two community pools. Take a FREE beach tram to the Gulf’s sugar-white sands or use the 7 included bikes to cruise 30A coast. Nearby Rosemary and Alys Beaches offer dining, shopping, and stunning views. Whether you’re looking to relax or make unforgettable memories, “Ca*SEA*ta” has it all. Ready to plan your escape? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Steps from 2 Seacrest Village Pools and Hot Tub, featuring a zero-entry pool great for kids 7 Bikes Included: Explore Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach with ease in this kid Beach Tram Access: Easy and FREE transportation to the white sands of 30A Luxury Amenities: Elevator access to all 3 levels and high-end finishes throughout Great Location: 50 feet to Peddler's Pavilion shops, dining, and live music Rosemary and Alys Beach Proximity: just a short 10-min stroll to Rosemary Beach and 13 to AlysEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "The house was perfection for our group of 14. Close to the pool, kids’ activities, and all the food spots. We will definitely be back!" – Ashli W. "We loved the short walks and tram rides to the beach. The included bikes were a hit, and the elevator made everything so convenient!" – Jennifer H. "The location couldn’t have been better! With stunning pools, nearby shops, and plenty of restaurants, everything was at our fingertips." – Kaylin H.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into the coastal elegance of Ca*SEA*ta, where open-concept living areas offer the perfect space to relax and connect. The second-floor main living area features plush seating and access to double balconies for tranquil outdoor moments. Spacious main living area with coastal décor Double balconies on the second floor for serene views Large Smart TV in the lounge for group entertainment*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Elevate your culinary experience in the fully equipped gourmet kitchen. With state-of-the-art appliances and plenty of seating, it’s perfect for everything from casual family breakfasts to elegant dinners. Fully equipped kitchen with top-tier appliances Dining table for 6, plus 3 more seats at the island Ideal for meal prep and group gatherings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: King Bedroom with En-Suite Bathroom Bunk Nook with 1 Twin Bunk Bed, perfect for kids2nd Floor: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bedroom with Attached Bathroom3rd Floor: 2 Guest Bedrooms with King Beds, Smart TVs, and shared hallway bathroom Primary Suite with King Bed, Smart TV, and Spa-Like En-Suite Bathroom*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Ca*SEA*ta is perfectly situated in the heart of Seacrest Beach, offering unmatched access to the area’s best amenities. Just steps from boutique shopping, live music at Peddler’s Pavilion, and 2 pools, it’s the ideal spot for your next getaway. Take a short walk or hop on the free beach tram for effortless trips to the sandy shores, and explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach for world-class dining and entertainment. Zero-entry pool and a second community pool Poolside deck with grills and outdoor seating for BBQs steps away Peddler’s Pavilion: Less than 2 minutes Local dining and live music: Steps from your door Rosemary Beach: 7 minutes Alys Beach: 11 minutes FREE seasonal beach tram for easy access to the shore Home to South Walton's tallest sand dunes*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes. It can be purchased during checkout or independently. We DO NOT accept wire transfers. LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach. This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes - a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 96186STRO #: STR-096186
